Range 30 feet

Targets 1 creature

Frequency once per day

Saving Throw Will

Duration 1 minute

The target must succeed at a Will save against your class DC or become fixated entirely on you for the duration: -2 circumstance penalty to Perception checks and to notice anything but you, and -2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls against anyone but you. On a critical failure, it also can't willingly end its turn out of your sight. This is an emotion, incapacitation, and mental effect.
